name: HallusionBench
intro: HallusionBench是一个全面的基准测试，旨在评估图像-上下文推理能力。该基准测试通过强调对视觉数据的细致理解和解释，对先进的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）提出了重大挑战。它包含346张图像和1129个问题，全部由人类专家精心制作。通过新颖的视觉问题结构和对照组设计，HallusionBench能够对模型的响应趋势、逻辑一致性和各种故障模式进行定量分析，并深入理解语言幻觉和视觉错觉等问题。
org: University of Maryland, University of California, Beijing Institute of Technology, Tencent AI Lab, C
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
metric: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc
modality: 图像, 文本, 多模态
intro_en: HallusionBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate image-context reasoning abilities. By emphasizing detailed understanding and interpretation of visual data, it poses significant challenges to advanced large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes 346 images and 1,129 questions, all carefully crafted by human experts. Through novel visual question structures and control group designs, HallusionBench enables quantitative analysis of model response patterns, logical consistency, and various failure modes, providing deep insights into issues such as language hallucination and visual illusions.
metric_en: Accuracy, Question Pair Acc, Figure Acc, Easy Question Acc, Hard Question Acc

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2310.14566v5, Sections 3-4, and official repository snapshot 744007c232c292942c7f80eb61edb2465482da31. The pinned artifact locator is HallusionBench.json with SHA256 ca6e0fb677dd56e5fb0e2700d06c58d01f8a6ae66e0f1773b2ac48c0a095d051. The paper and artifact agree on 165 original plus 181 human-edited images (346 total), 455 visual-question control pairs, and 1,129 rows split into 591 Visual Dependent and 538 Visual Supplement questions; the artifact also fixes 178 no-visual, 447 original-visual, and 504 edited-visual rows. Edits include flipping, order reversal, masking, OCR, object, and color changes. The paper-reported evaluation protocol uses a text-only GPT-4 judge at temperature 0 for three runs and averages scores. The pinned released harness keeps model generation user-supplied, makes one correctness-judge call per row, does not pass a temperature argument, and parses the output by matching incorrect to 0, then correct to 1, otherwise 2. The paper's binary rule and downstream analysis report aAcc, fAcc, qAcc, easy/hard accuracy, bias, consistency, and control-pair failure diagnosis.
